name: c3d-marketplace-public
description: Open-source Claude Code plugins from Cognitive3D — tools and skills for working with the Cognitive3D XR analytics platform

plugins.name: cognitive3d-public-api
plugins.description: Expert guide for the Cognitive3D (C3D) REST API — constructing requests, suggesting the right endpoints, filtering, and parsing responses.

plugins.name: cognitive3d-sdk-implementation
plugins.description: Cognitive3D SDK implementation strategy across Unity, Unreal, visionOS, Android XR, WebXR and C++ — guides SDK identification, discovery, data strategy, phased instrumentation, and technical routing for VR/AR/MR/WebXR analytics.

plugins.name: cognitive3d-ros2-integration
plugins.description: Integrate the Cognitive3D SDK for ROS 2 into a robot that already works — survey the live robot, decide each parameter from measurements, write the params file, wire launch, run doctor and verify the first session. Served from the SDK repository at its release tag, so the skill always matches the SDK version.
